questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Accessibility Auditing?
options: It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
accessibility is a property of interaction and information, not just visual treatment
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
questions.answer_key: accessibility is a property of interaction and information, not just visual treatment
questions.explanation: Accessibility Auditing is best understood through the syllabus topics: Browser accessibility inspectors, Automated accessibility checks, Keyboard testing. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with accessibility auditing?
options: Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
test keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, labels and names
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
questions.answer_key: test keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, labels and names
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Browser accessibility inspectors, Automated accessibility checks, Keyboard testing, Contrast testing.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying accessibility auditing?
options: do not rely on color alone to communicate errors or status
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
questions.answer_key: do not rely on color alone to communicate errors or status
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
